assets.name: guanguan
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this Guanguan bird woodcut. Keep the Chinese antique carved woodblock visual language, restrained ochre/celadon/ivory and black ink, genuinely transparent background. It must remain ONE dove-like bird, one head, two ordinary eyes, two wings, two legs and one tail. The source describes a dove-like bird whose call resembles people calling to one another; it DOES NOT give it extra eyes, horns, crests, human face or tails. Make its mythic personality visible through an emphatic calling pose: head tipped upwards, beak visibly open calling, arched throat and proudly extended breast, one wing lifted and opened in a sculptural fan while the other is folded, firmly planted feet. Replace realistic feather tracing with bold archaic carved cloud-scroll feather shapes and rhythmic ink/ivory negative spaces, an ancient bestiary emblem rather than an ordinary bird specimen. Slightly elongate the elegant neck and use a clear geometric eye motif while retaining two normal eyes and avian face. Keep these as artistic surface stylization, not claims of textual anatomy. No written sound effects, labels, speech bubbles, halo, talismans, jewelry, extra limbs or magical light. No modern objects. Full bird, no cropping, generous transparent margin, small simple rock under feet only.
assets.review_note: User review: open-beak calling pose with lifted wing and carved cloud-scroll feathers; dove-like anatomy retained, no invented horns/heads/tails. Transparent RGBA verified.
